title: A senior's discount with the booklet
summary: The discount screen shows what it takes off. The 5% on basic necessities needs the booklet; the senior gets the discount or wholesale, whichever is worth more.

steps.say: The meat is at the wholesale price. Press Discount
Pick SENIOR and type the ID number and name

steps.caption: The screen shows what the discount takes off. The booklet box starts unticked: without it, no 5% on basic necessities.

steps.say: Tick the booklet once it's shown and written in

steps.caption: Booklet ticked. The weekly cap box appears for when the booklet has less than the full 5% left.

The 5% is worth more than wholesale here, so the ribs go back to ₱330 with the senior discount ("SENIOR instead of wholesale"). The snack isn't discountable. The totals show each discount on its own line.

name: 20-senior-mixed
